beam_center_rule: Xbeam = Ybeam = detpixels * pixel / 2 (recomputed per cell when pixel varies)
notes: Detector locked at 2048x2048. Gate reproduces the 320 suite verbatim so the float ladder (184/320) stays comparable. Base geometry grounded from run_parity_suite_5090.sh. input_root is the read-only render-INPUT root (large, untracked-in-git): the crystal structure-factor .hkl (inputs/crystals/*.hkl, up to ~126MB) and the AMAT inputs (inputs/matrix/amat.mat, inputs/crystals/scaled.hkl) that the binary reads, plus the default reference binary nanoBragg_root. It holds NO verdict/TSV data -- expected/ (verdicts) and ledger/ (run data) are committed separately. It is relative to the harness root (this file's own directory's parent, i.e. cuda/test/ -- so "inputs" means cuda/test/inputs) and resolved to an absolute path at run time from base.json's own location, independent of the process's working directory. Each case's stored args carry the literal {input_root} token (e.g. {input_root}/crystals/193L.hkl), expanded to this path per run; the tokenized form is what args_hash is computed over, keeping the cache key machine-independent. base_geometry_dims names the dimensions whose baseline values form the invariant BASE geometry (distance/lambda/pixel), matching run_parity_suite_5090.sh.
